definitions.explanation: A daughter of a king or queen; a female member of a royal family.

examples.japanese: {王女|おうじょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ていた→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: The princess was wearing a beautiful dress.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{王女|おうじょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{魔法使|まほうつか}い→魔法使い：15532_mahoutsukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{助|たす}けられる→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧。
examples.english: In the story, the princess is saved by a wizard.

examples.japanese: ⟦ダイアナ→ダイアナ：noentry⟧{王女|おうじょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{愛|あい}されていた→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧。
examples.english: Princess Diana was loved around the world.

examples.japanese: {王女|おうじょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{王子|おうじ}→王子：01904_ouji⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}して→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦{幸|しあわ}せに→幸せ：01420_shiawase⟧⟦{暮|く}らした→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: The princess married the prince and lived happily.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{王女|おうじょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{敬|うやま}われていた→敬う：00417_uyamau⟧。
examples.english: The princess of that country was deeply respected by the people.

notes:
USAGE: {王女|おうじょ} specifically refers to a king's daughter (princess by birth), used for foreign royalty.

JAPANESE IMPERIAL FAMILY:
For Japanese imperial princesses, different terms are used:
- ⟦{皇女|こうじょ}→皇女：24369_koujo⟧ - imperial princess (daughter of Emperor)
- ⟦{内親王|ないしんのう}→内親王：noentry⟧ - princess (official title)
- ⟦{女王|じょおう}→女王：03349_joou⟧ - princess (lower rank); also means 'queen'

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{王子|おうじ}→王子：01904_ouji⟧ - prince (male counterpart)
- ⟦{女王|じょおう}→女王：03349_joou⟧ - queen
- ⟦{国王|こくおう}→国王：04152_kokuou⟧ - king
- ⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧ - king
- ⟦{姫|ひめ}→姫：12233_hime⟧ - princess (literary, fairy tales)
